zh.site.title: ModernChat — 自托管、插件优先的团队聊天
zh.site.desc: 账号、好友、单聊群聊、文本 / 图片 / 语音 / 视频开箱即用；表情、主题、机器人、小游戏由可插拔的 JS 插件提供。Go + Vue 3，Apache-2.0 自托管。
zh.hero.eyebrow: 插件优先的网页聊天平台
zh.hero.sub: 账号、好友、单聊群聊、文本 / 图片 / 语音 / 视频开箱即用。表情、主题、机器人、小游戏全部是可装卸的 JS 插件——跑在沙箱里，碰不到 DOM，也拿不到登录凭据。
zh.hero.f2: 单二进制 + 静态前端
zh.cap.title:
内核只做该做的事，
其余交给插件
zh.cap.desc: 账号、好友、会话、消息、治理与运维构成不可禁用的内核；表情、主题、机器人这类增强能力一律通过插件提供，卸掉插件就回到一个干净的 IM。
zh.cap.1d: 文本、图片、语音、视频；引用回复、提及提醒、消息编辑与撤回。
zh.cap.2d: 群公告、群文件、邀请链接（免登录可看群信息）、管理员与禁言。
zh.cap.3d: 置顶、免打扰、归档、草稿、已读回执，多端未读同步。
zh.cap.4d: 虚拟滚动 + 游标分页，万条历史不卡；断线重连自动补齐消息。
zh.cap.5d: JWT 主动失效、找回密码、封禁强制下线、注册邀请码。
zh.cap.6d: 拉黑、举报、管理员删消息、敏感词过滤、登录失败锁定。
zh.cap.7d: 用户管理、插件上下架、全站公告、操作审计与系统设置。
zh.cap.8d: 环境自检、下载发行版、建库、systemd + nginx 全自动，服务器不用装 Go / Node。
zh.cap.9d: 新版本就绪后原子切换，在线用户自动重连并补齐消息。
zh.cap.10d: 健康检查、版本信息、Prometheus 指标、结构化日志与定时备份。
zh.plug.title: 插件能加能力，但越不过权限边界
zh.plug.sub: 每个插件是一个 JS 文件（不超过 1MB），由宿主装进 sandbox iframe。它不接触 DOM、拿不到 token，界面只能提交描述式 JSON，由白名单组件渲染。
zh.plug.s1d: allow-scripts、无 same-origin，postMessage 是唯一通道。
zh.plug.s2d: api.request 由宿主代发，只放行 allowedHosts 的域名，并做 SSRF 防护。
zh.plug.s3d: manifest 里写清权限，安装时弹出清单，确认后才启用。
zh.plug.s4d: 站长按插件名整体下架，对所有用户立即生效。
zh.plug.uiDesc: 白名单外的组件、javascript: 链接一律拒绝渲染。
zh.plug.p1: 订阅消息、撤回、在线状态与会话打开事件
zh.plug.p2: 向会话发送消息（对象自动 JSON 序列化）
zh.plug.p3: 注册自定义消息类型的渲染器
zh.plug.p4: 提交侧边栏面板的界面描述
zh.plug.p5: 每插件独立的本地存储，单值不超过 64KB
zh.plug.p6: 由宿主代发 HTTP 请求，仅限白名单域名

en.site.title: ModernChat — self-hosted, plugin-first team chat
en.site.desc: Accounts, friends, DMs and groups, text / image / voice / video ship in the core. Emoji, themes, bots and mini-games all come from pluggable JS plugins. Go + Vue 3, Apache-2.0.
en.hero.sub: Accounts, friends, DMs and groups, text / image / voice / video are all in the core. Emoji, themes, bots and mini-games are installable JS plugins — sandboxed, with no DOM access and no access to your token.
en.cap.title:
The core does the essentials,
plugins do the rest
en.cap.desc: Accounts, friends, conversations, messages, moderation and ops form a core you cannot disable. Emoji, themes and bots always come as plugins — remove them and you get a clean IM back.
en.cap.1d: Text, images, voice and video, with quotes, mentions, editing and recall.
en.cap.2d: Announcements, shared files, invite links (readable without signing in), admins and mute.
en.cap.3d: Pin, mute, archive, drafts and read receipts, with unread state synced across devices.
en.cap.4d: Virtual scrolling and cursor pagination, so long histories stay smooth; reconnect backfills what you missed.
en.cap.5d: JWT with token_version revocation, password reset, ban kick-out and invite codes.
en.cap.6d: Blocking, reporting, admin message deletion, sensitive-word filter and login lockout.
en.cap.7d: User management, plugin takedown, announcements, audit log and site settings.
en.cap.8d: Environment checks, release download, database, systemd and nginx — no Go or Node on the server.
en.cap.9d: Atomic switch once the new build is ready; clients reconnect and backfill automatically.
en.cap.10d: Health and version endpoints, Prometheus metrics, structured logs and scheduled backups.
en.plug.title: Plugins add capability, never cross the boundary
en.plug.sub: A plugin is one JS file (up to 1MB) loaded into a sandbox iframe. It has no DOM access and no token; its UI is descriptive JSON rendered by whitelisted components.
en.plug.s1d: allow-scripts without same-origin; postMessage is the only channel.
en.plug.s2d: api.request goes through the host, only for allowedHosts, with SSRF protection.
en.plug.s3d: Declared in the manifest, shown as a checklist, enabled only after you confirm.
en.plug.s4d: An admin can ban a plugin by name for every user, effective immediately.
en.plug.uiDesc: Anything else, including javascript: links, is refused at render time.
en.plug.p1: Subscribe to messages, recalls, presence and conversation-open events
en.plug.p2: Send messages to a conversation (objects are JSON serialized)
en.plug.p3: Register a renderer for a custom message type
en.plug.p4: Submit a side panel UI description
en.plug.p6: HTTP requests proxied by the host, whitelisted domains only
en.plug.codeManifest: /* manifest goes in the first block comment */
en.plug.codePanel: // side panel: descriptive UI only, no DOM access
en.dep.title: One command, no Go or Node on the server
en.dep.sub: Production servers download a prebuilt release — nothing is compiled. For local work use Docker Compose or run the source.
en.dep.note: Every prompt has a default, so hitting enter walks through it; environment variables can preset domain, database and release source.
en.dep.c1: # fresh Linux server, run as root; no Go / Node / git needed
en.dep.c2: # it handles arch detection, release download, database, systemd + nginx
en.dep.c3: # every prompt has a default — press enter through it, or preset env vars
en.dep.c6: # change JWT_SECRET for custom keys (openssl rand -hex 32)
en.dep.o1d: /api/health and /api/version confirm whether an upgrade actually landed.
en.dep.o2d: update.sh downloads the release, verifies sha256, swaps atomically and restarts.
en.dep.o3d: Prometheus at /api/metrics, optionally protected by METRICS_TOKEN.
en.dep.o4d: Manual or scheduled database backups, plus periodic orphan attachment cleanup.
en.eco.title: Docs, examples and releases
en.eco.1d: Design trade-offs, API contracts, frontend guide and ops manual — eight documents.
en.eco.2d: Example plugins ready to download, with permission lists and install steps.
en.eco.3d: Every feature, fix and security change, by version.
en.eco.4d: Go + Vue 3 + MySQL, Apache-2.0, actively developed on Gitee.
en.band.title: Your own instance, ten minutes from now
en.band.sub: Apache-2.0 · single instance · your data stays yours
en.footer.line: A plugin-first web chat platform. The core stays clean, capabilities come from plugins you can remove.
